failures.case: arch/119 FF-11901 · 121: NO control under test/arch/ spells an import-specifier extractor of its own — the one home is test/support/module-family.mjs, and the remainder is a named, shrink-only baseline
failures.message:
error: "a control that spells its own `from "…"` extractor is the twenty-first home of a function that has one (test/support/module-family.mjs), and the copies disagree about multi-line clauses, `export … from`, the bare form, `require(` and `import(`. Import `importSpecifiers` from the one home and read `.specifier` off each entry; a file that needs the CLAUSE or the CALL FORM is a decision about the home and belongs in EXTRACTOR_BASELINE with its reason, never absorbed silently:
  - test/arch/practices/acd-render-reads-project-config-only.test.mjs:26 — /import\s[^;]*?from\s*["']([^"']+)/
  - test/arch/practices/acd-render-reads-project-config-only.test.mjs:26 — /import\s*["']([^"']+)/
  - test/arch/practices/acd-render-reads-project-config-only.test.mjs:26 — /\bimport\(\s*["']([^"']+)/
+ actual - expected

+ [
+   `test/arch/practices/acd-render-reads-project-config-only.test.mjs:26 — /import\\s[^;]*?from\\s*["']([^"']+)/`,
+   `test/arch/practices/acd-render-reads-project-config-only.test.mjs:26 — /import\\s*["']([^"']+)/`,
+   `test/arch/practices/acd-render-reads-project-config-only.test.mjs:26 — /\\bimport\\(\\s*["']([^"']+)/`
+ ]
